name: unslop-korean
description: Polish interfaces with unslop’s nine design passes and evidence-based Korean copy review.

interface.shortDescription: Polish UI design and Korean copy
interface.longDescription: Adapted from unslop by Damir Sokolovsky: spacing, color, icons, Korean copy, type, layout, details, visuals and motion. Korean copy review uses published UX and Korean-language evidence across the affected funnel, preserving other languages. Includes native audit tools. Copy-only requests do not authorize redesign.
defaultPrompt: 이 화면의 디자인을 개선하고 한국어 문구를 사용자 흐름과 실제 동작에 맞게 다듬어 줘.
